subject: Project Coordinator, Winton (QLD/703863/26): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello RoadTek team,

I am applying for the Project Coordinator role in Winton advertised on SEEK and SmartJobs (QLD/703863/26).

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project in charge, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day, and then as a field engineer tracking procurement and materials and preparing progress reports. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers on road works, with support for tendering and estimating, is the work I want to build on. My coordination experience is from the Philippines rather than Australian road crews, and I am open to discussing relocation to Winton.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Estimator / Scheduler, Scoresby: Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello FTA team,

I am applying for the Estimator / Scheduler role in Scoresby advertised on SEEK (job 95206941).

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. My coursework included cost estimates, bills of quantities and AS 1726 geotechnical site investigation. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge, tracking procurement and materials and preparing progress reports. I am based in Melton, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert says estimating experience is an advantage but not essential, which suits me: my estimating so far is coursework, not a paid role, and I want to learn foundation work properly from your engineers.

Could we arrange a short conversation about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
